fusions.name: Silver Run
fusions.desc: Throws a crescent of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. For 3 seconds after you use it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Scale and Gut
fusions.desc: A gutting cut that deals 18 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control effects from you, restores 10 health and increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Line
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
